Consultation outcome

An SBAR is generated for all outcomes — required for IP governance regardless of outcome. Scotland: NHS Pharmacy First Plus prescribing requires GP10 pad and SBAR sent to GP practice.

🏴 NHS Scotland — Pharmacy First Plus: Prescriptions under PFP+ must be written on your NHS Board-issued GP10 pad. Submit a UCF Supply claim via PharmOutcomes / your claim system. SBAR required for GP practice records. Claim code: NHS Pharmacy First Plus Supply. Activity pot payment applies from November 2025 (PCA(P)(2025)24).

NHS Pharmacy First Scotland — PGDs & Assessment Forms

Source: NHS Greater Glasgow & Clyde Community Pharmacy · communitypharmacy.scot.nhs.uk ↗ · Last updated June 2026

⚠ Important: Every pharmacist must sign an individual copy of each PGD before undertaking the associated service. Signed PGDs must be retained in the pharmacy for 8 years from the effective date. From 1 April 2026, NHSGGC no longer requires submission of signed authorisation sheets — signing the PGD itself is sufficient. Always verify current versions with your Health Board.
🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿 NHS Scotland Pharmacy First Service (PFS)
Pharmacy First Scotland PGDs — valid across all 14 Scottish Health Boards (subject to local Board authorisation)
🌸 Hay Fever / Allergic Rhinitis & Eye Conditions
📄 PGD — Beclometasone 50μg Nasal Spray v2 exp May 2029 📄 PGD — Fexofenadine 120mg Tablets v2 exp May 2029 📄 PGD — Mometasone Furoate 50μg Nasal Spray v2 exp May 2029 📄 PGD — Olopatadine 1mg/ml Eye Drops v2 exp May 2029 📋 Patient Assessment Form — Hay Fever v2
🫦 Oral Thrush (Candidiasis)
📄 PGD — Nystatin Oral Suspension v1 exp Mar 2029 📋 Patient Assessment Form — Nystatin v1
🩹 Impetigo
Age ≥1 year · Localised (≤4 lesion clusters) · Exclude: pregnant <16, bullous impetigo, recurrent (≥2 in 12 months), immunosuppressed, widespread infection
📄 PGD — Fusidic Acid 2% Cream v3 exp Aug 2028 📋 Patient Assessment Form — Impetigo v3
🫘 Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
Women aged 16–64 · Uncomplicated lower UTI only · Exclude: male, pregnant, breastfeeding, catheter, recurrent UTI (≥2 in 6 months or ≥3 in 12 months), symptoms >7 days, loin pain/fever (→ pyelonephritis)
⚠ Antibiotic choice varies by Health Board — check your Board's current guidance. Tayside: Nitrofurantoin 1st line (if test results available). All other Boards: Trimethoprim 1st line.
📄 PGD — Nitrofurantoin v3 exp Aug 2028 📄 PGD — Trimethoprim v3 exp Aug 2028 📋 Patient Assessment Form — UTI v3
⚡ Shingles (Herpes Zoster)
Age ≥18 years · Present within 72 hours of rash onset (or active blistering) · Exclude: pregnant or suspected pregnancy, breastfeeding with shingles on breast, ophthalmic involvement (→ refer), immunosuppressed, Ramsay Hunt syndrome
📄 PGD — Aciclovir 800mg v2 exp Feb 2027 📋 Patient Assessment Form — Aciclovir (Shingles) v2
🔴 Bacterial Skin Infections (Infected Insect Bites / Cellulitis)
Age ≥1 year · Infection present or worsening ≥48 hours after bite/sting · Localised infection · Exclude: pregnant <16, widespread infection, immunosuppressed, allergy to flucloxacillin / penicillin
📄 PGD — Flucloxacillin v2 exp Feb 2027 📋 Patient Assessment Form — Flucloxacillin v2
🩹 Skin Inflammation / Allergy / Itch (Eczema)
Hydrocortisone 1% — mild topical steroid for inflammatory skin conditions · Emollients vary by Health Board (see approved list section 10.1)
📄 PGD — Hydrocortisone 1% Cream/Ointment v1 exp Jan 2029 📋 Patient Assessment & GP Notification Form — Hydrocortisone v1.1
🚑 NHS Scotland — Unscheduled Care
Out-of-hours emergency supply PGD — valid across NHS Scotland
⚕️ Unscheduled Care v32
📄 PGD — Unscheduled Care v32 exp Oct 2027 📋 Authorisation Sheet v32 📋 What's New — v32 📋 Medicines A–Z Look-up List v2.2 (Apr 2026) 📋 Direct Referral Contact Numbers v32
💊 NHSGGC Pharmacy Public Health Service (PHS)
NHS Greater Glasgow & Clyde local public health pharmacy services
🩺 Emergency Hormonal Contraception (EHC) v13
📄 PGD — Levonorgestrel v13 exp Aug 2027 📋 EHC Patient Assessment Proforma & Flowchart v1
💊 Bridging Contraception — Progesterone Only Pill v2
📄 PGD — Desogestrel (Bridging Contraception) v2 exp Sept 2027 📋 GP Notification Form v2 📋 Combined EHC & Bridging Contraception Assessment Form v1 📋 Supporting Guidance — EHC & Bridging Contraception v1
🚭 Varenicline (Smoking Cessation) v1
📄 PGD — Varenicline Tablets v1 exp Apr 2028 📋 Patient Assessment Form — Varenicline v1 📋 NHS Circular PCA(P)(2025) 06

Clinical support & peer network

If you are uncertain about a prescribing decision, have a complex presentation, or need peer support — these are the right people to contact.

🏴󠁧󠁢󠁳󠁣󠁴󠁿
CPS IP Peer Network
Community Pharmacy Scotland — IP WhatsApp group, monthly Teams peer support meetings
🎓
NES Teach & Treat
Clinical skills support for newly qualified community pharmacy IPs — enquiries@cps.scot
🏥
Right Decisions Scotland
NHS Scotland clinical decision support — local ADTC guidelines, pathways, protocols
💊
SPS — Specialist Pharmacy Service
Medicines information, complex prescribing queries, unlicensed use, special populations
🔍
NHS Inform Scotland
Patient-facing and clinical condition information for Scotland
📚
NES TURAS Learn
IP resources, CPD modules, clinical skills — Scotland only
📞 If in doubt — contact your local Health Board medicines information service or call NHS 24 (111) to discuss a clinical query before prescribing. Documenting that you sought peer advice is good governance practice.

⚠ Clinical Disclaimer

This tool is a clinical documentation aid for use by GPhC-registered pharmacists and independent prescribers only. It does not constitute medical advice and must not override clinical judgement. The prescriber remains solely and professionally responsible for all clinical decisions, diagnoses and prescriptions. All formulary data, drug interactions, evidence links and clinical content must be verified at source — BNF, NICE, SMC, eMC SPC, Stockley's — before prescribing. Drug interaction and allergy alerts are decision support aids, not a substitute for professional clinical assessment. In an emergency always call 999.
